flashcards.question: How can a north-south choke study question be made more specific before choosing a lesson?
flashcards.answer: Classify it as an entry, alignment or blocking-arm question. Garcia’s public contents provide distinct material for those subjects; the category alone does not diagnose the technical error.

start_here.title: Classify the obstacle before choosing an entry lesson
start_here.task: Compare the Volume 1 alignment heading with the frame-clearing headings in Volume 3. In footage you can access, note whether the attack never forms or forms and then loses contact; leave the correction undecided. Owners can begin with alignment before selecting an entry from a familiar top position.
